## What is AI? {.scrollable}

:::::: {layout-ncol="2"}
::: {}
- A collection of **technologies** that puts the emphasis on prediction, using intensive data learning.
- Common laguage = LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.)
- A sequence of HTTP requests and HTTP responses in JSON
:::

## How does AI Urban Studies? {.scrollable}

::::: {layout-ncol="2"}
::: {}
- Creates **distrust** and suspicion (students essay, peer review articles, data, emails)
- Increases **wealth concentration and inequality** (access, gender and geographical representation in references, hallucinated or not)
- Wastes considerable **time and energy**
- Gives computer scientists **disproportionate power** over scientific tools and means of research
- Creates **vulnerability** (to draughts, to climate change, to proprietary workflows) and **intellectual laziness** which impairs learning and facilitates political manipulation
:::

::: {}

## What can be done? {.scrollable}

::::: {layout-ncol="2"}
::: {}
- Be **aware**: learn how it works, who produces it, why, how much it costs to produce and why it's free to use
- Be **careful**: what are you giving away (real world actions), what do you claim as yours
- **Resist!**
:::
